annotation_note: The tissue polygon defines the visible corneal/limbal tissue band. For LabelMe-source images, the original LabelMe cornea polygon is displayed only as a visual reference; the complete anterior and posterior boundaries are manually annotated using the same procedure as the other datasets. The anterior boundary between left_CLJ and right_CLJ is defined as cornea; anterior-boundary points outside those junctions are defined as limbus. The CLJ points themselves belong to the corneal region. For preprocessing, the posterior boundary is also the hard lower mask boundary: pixels immediately below it are excluded with zero lower margin.
